mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) potentiates the anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects of meclizine (antihistamine), and meclizine may have weak serotonergic properties that could theoretically interact with MAOI therapy.
action: Use with caution; monitor for excessive sedation, anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation), and orthostatic hypotension; consider alternative antiemetic if possible.
